papers.title: Vector competence of northern and southern European Culex pipiens pipiens mosquitoes for West Nile virus across a gradient of temperatures
papers.summary: This sample record illustrates the arbovirus fields. The study compared northern and southern European Culex pipiens pipiens mosquitoes under different temperatures using experimental WNV infection data.
papers.mainFinding: Temperature affected WNV transmission potential in European Cx. pipiens populations.
papers.whyItMatters: It connects vector competence, thermal conditions and European transmission risk in the main vector species relevant to the digest.
papers.studyPeriod: Laboratory experiment; collection period not shown in sample metadata
papers.europeanTransmissionRisk: Shows how thermal conditions can change competence estimates for European transmission.

papers.title: Vector competence of northern European Culex pipiens biotypes and hybrids for West Nile virus is differentially affected by temperature
papers.summary: This sample record demonstrates how thermal and biotype information is displayed. The available metadata indicates that northern European Culex pipiens biotypes and hybrids were tested for WNV competence at different temperatures.
papers.mainFinding: Temperature modified vector competence patterns among northern European Cx. pipiens forms.
papers.whyItMatters: It is methodologically relevant to common-garden and thermal-assay interpretation because it separates mosquito form and thermal environment.
papers.studyPeriod: Laboratory experiment; collection period not shown in sample metadata
papers.europeanTransmissionRisk: Clarifies how northern European mosquito forms may contribute under different thermal regimes.

papers.title: Sindbis virus circulation in European mosquito and avian host networks sample preprint
